scientific_integrity.computational_role: Finite independent graph checks and exact rational generating-function expansions corroborate, but do not establish, the infinite proof.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exact bijection to spanning bipartite linear forests, labeled component exponential formula, and direct extremal bijections.

scientific_limitations: The full bivariate polynomial identity is proved only for Cartesian products of two complete graphs; the result does not address arbitrary line graphs, higher-dimensional rook graphs, or induced connected trees.
The extremal formulas count labeled optimum vertex sets, not equivalence classes under graph symmetries.
The maximum induced forest cardinalities recover tabulated decycling numbers and are not claimed as new scalar results.
Publication priority is not independently certified; a different literature treatment of labeled bipartite linear forests may imply the same enumeration.
title: Acyclic polynomials and extremal induced forests of rook graphs
